# Staff Parking Permits

Every full-time employee may apply for one parking permit per year. Permits are issued through the Facilities Portal and cost USD 250 for twelve months.

Applications for the 2025 permit cycle open on 1 March 2025 and close on 31 March 2025. Late applications are placed on a waiting list.

A lost permit can be replaced once per year for a fee of USD 50. Visitors must use the visitor car park on Level B2 and register at reception.
